section_text_plain: Defines a 'defect' as any fault, imperfection, or shortcoming in the quality, quantity, potency, purity, or standard which is required to be maintained by or under any law for the time being in force or under any contract, express or implied.
limitation_period: 2 years from the date on which the cause of action arises.

section_text_plain: Defines 'deficiency' as any fault, imperfection, shortcoming or inadequacy in the quality, nature and manner of performance which is required to be maintained by or under any law or undertaken to be performed by a person in pursuance of a contract.
limitation_period: 2 years from the date on which the cause of action arises.

section_text_plain: Provides that in the absence of a written contract or local usage to the contrary, a lease of immovable property for agricultural or manufacturing purposes shall be deemed to be a lease from year to year, terminable, on the part of either lessor or lessee, by six months' notice; and a lease of immovable property for any other purpose shall be deemed to be a lease from month to month, terminable, on the part of either lessor or lessee, by fifteen days' notice.
limitation_period: 12 years for recovery of possession under Article 65 of Limitation Act.

section_text_plain: Specific performance of a contract can be enforced. A tenancy agreement is a contract, and failure to return the deposit is a breach.
limitation_period: 3 years from the date the deposit became refundable.

section_text_plain: Deals with claims arising out of deductions from wages or delay in payment of wages and penalty for malicious or vexatious claims.
remedy_forum: Authority under the Payment of Wages Act / Labour Court
limitation_period: 12 months from the date on which the deduction from wages was made or from the date on which the payment of the wages was due.

section_text_plain: Provides that the dismissal, retrenchment, or termination of an individual workman shall be deemed to be an industrial dispute.
limitation_period: 3 years from the date of discharge, dismissal, retrenchment or otherwise termination of service.

section_text_plain: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty.
limitation_period: Subject to Section 468 of CrPC / BNSS (generally 3 years for offenses punishable with imprisonment up to 3 years).
